Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect can only place [Sistermon Blanc].
Card Q&A.q: Can I place a [Sistermon Blanc (Awakened)] from my hand or trash at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards with this card's [On Play] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. Those cards have [Huckmon] and/or [Sistermon] in their names, so you can add one of them to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Deletion] effect return [BaoHuckmon], [SaviorHuckmon], or [Sistermon Ciel (Awakened)] from my trash to my hand?

Effect: [On Play] You may place 1 [Sistermon Blanc] from your hand or trash at the bottom of this Digimon's digivolution cards to ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[On Deletion] Return 1 card with [Jesmon], [Huckmon], or [Sistermon] in its name other than [Sistermon Blanc (Awakened)] from your trash to your hand.
